description: No sleeve vent means the cuff hem is a plain, uninterrupted finish with no slit, no overlap, and no buttons — the sleeve simply ends at the wrist in a clean line. This is the most minimal and economical sleeve finish, common on unlined summer jackets and casual sportswear where the understatement is intentional. It allows the most flexibility in sleeve length alteration after the fact and lends the jacket a clean, modern sensibility devoid of traditional tailoring signifiers.
